cards.name: Voice of the Conclave
cards.oracle_text_summary: When this enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier token. Other creatures you control get +0/+1. Whenever a creature token enters under your control, you may gain 1 life.

cards.name: Trostani, Grove Warden
cards.oracle_text_summary: Lifelink. Populate at the beginning of your upkeep. Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

cards.name: Rootborn Sentinel
cards.oracle_text_summary: Whenever another creature enters under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Emmara, Soul of the Accord
cards.oracle_text_summary: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token with lifelink.

cards.name: Sunhome Evangelist
cards.oracle_text_summary: When this enters, creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn. Tap up to two creatures: create a 1/1 white Soldier token for each creature tapped this way.

cards.name: Collective Blessing

cards.name: Glare of Subdual
cards.oracle_text_summary: Tap an untapped creature you control: tap target artifact or creature.

cards.name: Growing Ranks
cards.oracle_text_summary: At the beginning of your upkeep, populate.

cards.name: Intangible Virtue
cards.oracle_text_summary: Creature tokens you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance.

cards.name: Rootborn Defenses

cards.name: Sundering Growth
cards.oracle_text_summary: Destroy target artifact or enchantment, then populate.

cards.oracle_text_summary: Create a 3/3 green Centaur creature token.

cards.name: Advent of the Wurm

cards.oracle_text_summary: When this enters, create a 2/2 white Knight token with vigilance, a 3/3 green Centaur token, and a 4/4 green Rhino token with trample.

cards.name: Wayfaring Temple
cards.oracle_text_summary: Power and toughness each equal the number of creatures you control. Whenever this deals combat damage, populate.

cards.name: Armada Wurm
cards.oracle_text_summary: Trample. When this enters, create a 5/5 green Wurm creature token with trample.

cards.oracle_text_summary: {3}{G}: Create a 1/1 green Saproling token. {3}{W}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.

cards.name: Horncaller's Chant
cards.oracle_text_summary: Create a 4/4 green Rhino token with trample, then populate.

cards.name: Grove of the Guardian
cards.oracle_text_summary: Tap, tap two other untapped creatures you control, sacrifice this: create an 8/8 green Elemental creature token with vigilance.

cards.name: Centaur's Herald
cards.oracle_text_summary: Sacrifice this creature: create a 3/3 green Centaur creature token.

cards.name: Selesnya Evangel
cards.oracle_text_summary: Tap, discard a land: create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

cards.name: Hour of Reckoning
cards.oracle_text_summary: Convoke. Destroy all nontoken creatures.

cards.name: Worldspine Wurm
cards.oracle_text_summary: Trample. When this dies, create three 5/5 green Wurm tokens with trample. When this is put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library.

cards.name: Phantom General
cards.oracle_text_summary: Creature tokens you control get +1/+1.

cards.name: Bower Passage
cards.oracle_text_summary: Creatures you control with flying can't be blocked by creatures without flying.

cards.name: Verdant Confluence
cards.oracle_text_summary: Choose three, with repetition allowed: put two +1/+1 counters on target creature; return target permanent card from graveyard to hand; or search your library for a basic land, put it into play tapped.

cards.name: Selesnya Keyrune
cards.oracle_text_summary: Tap: add {G} or {W}. {G}{W}: This becomes a 3/3 green and white Wolf creature with vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Selesnya Locket
cards.oracle_text_summary: Tap: add {G} or {W}. {G}{G}{W}{W}, tap, sacrifice this: draw two cards.

cards.name: Trostani Discordant
cards.oracle_text_summary: Other creatures you control get +1/+1. When this enters, create two 1/1 white Soldier tokens with lifelink. At end of turn, each player gains control of all creatures they own.

cards.name: Ajani, Mentor of Heroes
cards.oracle_text_summary: +1: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among up to three creatures. +1: Look at top four cards; put any creatures or Auras into hand. -8: Gain 100 life.

cards.name: Huatli, Radiant Champion
cards.oracle_text_summary: +1: Huatli gets loyalty counters equal to the number of creatures you control. -1: Target creature gains trample and gets +X/+X where X is number of creatures you control until end of turn. -8: Enchantment; draw a card whenever a creature enters.
